experimental_scope: Full original EDNM electrodiffusive dynamics, 2 units, sealed boundaries, 2 second horizon, 0.5 sec localized neuron-to-ECS K transfer; baseline-subtracted. Glial spatial Nernst-Planck mobility includes Na,K,Cl and is NOT potassium-specific
limitations: Glial-off fine-timestep intervention is outstanding, so source-intervention numerical difference is not independently demonstrated converged
No experimental noise distribution, so physical detectability not established
Original model shares two-unit chain topology across compartments; cannot assess distinct glial vs neuronal network geometry
The perturbed source glial spatial mobility affects Na/K/Cl, not K alone
Extreme factor x2000 is numerical sensitivity stress, not physiological parameter range
No neuronal firing-rate observable, only membrane potential
Not experimentally calibrated to a specific preparation
